mapper.select: SELECT * FROM study_stats WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND stat_date = #{statDate} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_stats (user_id, course_id, stat_date, video_duration, doc_duration, total_duration, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{statDate}, #{videoDuration}, #{docDuration}, #{totalDuration}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE video_duration = VALUES(video_duration), doc_duration = VALUES(doc_duration), total_duration = VALUES(total_duration), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO study_stats (user_id, course_id, stat_date, video_duration, doc_duration, total_duration, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{statDate}, #{videoDelta}, #{docDelta}, #{totalDelta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE video_duration = video_duration + #{videoDelta}, doc_duration = doc_duration + #{docDelta}, total_duration = total_duration + #{totalDelta}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM study_stats WHERE stat_date = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM study_stats WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate}
SELECT AVG(total_duration) FROM study_stats WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.submission_id) FROM submission s INNER JOIN task t ON s.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.course_id = #{courseId}) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE course_id = #{courseId}), 0), 0 )
